title: Show HN: A pure ARM64 Assembly web server, now on Linux with CGI for no reason
summary: A hobbyist project building a fully functional web server from scratch using only ARM64 Assembly language, now supporting CGI scripting for dynamic content and cross-platform compatibility between macOS and Linux.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how web servers fundamentally work at the hardware level by implementing one entirely in raw assembly language.
why_valuable: Provides an educational deep-dive into low-level systems programming, HTTP protocol internals, and ARM64 architecture while showcasing extreme optimization and minimalism.
